whyEn: Dyspnea is one of the highest-volume medical complaints in EMS, and this 121-page chapter is the backbone of every shortness-of-breath scenario question: telling asthma, COPD, heart failure, pulmonary embolism, and pneumothorax apart, reading work of breathing before the monitor catches up, and running the BC treatment ladder (oxygen, salbutamol/ipratropium, epinephrine, dexamethasone, CPAP). It also carries the single most dangerous textbook-versus-BC conflict in the whole program: oxygen strategy for the COPD patient.
whyZh: 呼吸困难是出勤量最大的内科主诉之一，这个 121 页的大章几乎撑起所有 SOB 场景题：哮喘、COPD、心衰、肺栓塞、气胸怎么分；监护仪还没报警之前怎么从呼吸做功看出危险；以及 BC 的处置阶梯（给氧、沙丁胺醇/异丙托溴铵、肾上腺素、地塞米松、CPAP）怎么走。它还藏着整个课程里最危险的一处教材与 BC 考纲冲突——COPD 病人的给氧策略。

points.en: Nasal tubes (nasotracheal, NG) must travel parallel to the floor of the nose — never angled upward toward the fragile cribriform plate. The vessel-rich turbinates swell and bleed easily.
points.zh: 经鼻置管（鼻气管管、鼻胃管）必须沿鼻底平行推进，绝不能朝上顶向脆弱的筛板。鼻甲血管丰富，很容易肿胀出血。

points.en: Suspected allergic reaction: ask whether the tongue feels thick, listen for a raspy or fading voice, and inspect for uvular swelling — these are the early warnings of laryngeal edema and angioedema (classically triggered by ACE inhibitors or stings).
points.zh: 怀疑过敏反应时要问舌头是否发胀，听声音有没有变哑变小，看悬雍垂肿没肿——这些是喉头水肿和血管性水肿的早期信号（经典诱因：ACE 抑制剂、蜂蜇）。

points.en: The cricoid is the airway's only complete cartilage ring; pressing it squeezes the esophagus against the C6 vertebral body. The cricothyroid membrane sits in the gap above it — the cricothyrotomy site, chosen because it has few vessels and only thin skin over it.
points.zh: 环状软骨是气道唯一的完整软骨环，按压它会把食管压向第 6 颈椎椎体。它上方的空隙就是环甲膜——环甲膜切开的入路，选这里正因为血管少、表面只覆盖薄薄的皮肤。

points.en: A tube jammed in the piriform fossa shows as visible tenting on the neck — pull back a few centimetres and redirect.
points.zh: 管子卡进梨状窝时颈部外观会看到「顶起」，处理是回退几厘米再重新送入。

points.en: The trachea runs 10-13 cm from about C6 to the carina near T5 (roughly nipple level). The right mainstem takes off at a shallower angle, so over-deep tubes and inhaled foreign bodies almost always go right.
points.zh: 气管长 10-13 cm，从约 C6 延伸到 T5 附近的隆突（大致乳头水平）。右主支气管分出的角度更平缓，所以插得过深的气管管和吸入的异物几乎都进右侧。

points.en: Anatomic dead space is fixed at about 2 mL/kg ideal weight (75 kg ≈ 150 mL). Because it never shrinks, a falling tidal volume eats alveolar ventilation disproportionately: at VT 700 mL, 550 mL reaches alveoli; drop VT to 500 mL and only 350 mL does.
points.zh: 解剖死腔固定在约 2 mL/kg 理想体重（75 kg 约 150 mL）。死腔不会缩小，所以潮气量一降，肺泡通气被成倍侵蚀：潮气量 700 mL 时有 550 mL 到达肺泡；降到 500 mL 时就只剩 350 mL。

points.en: Airway smooth muscle only wraps down to the subsegmental level, so bronchodilators only fix wheeze caused by muscle spasm. Wheeze that survives salbutamol points to inflammation or edema instead.
points.zh: 气道平滑肌只包裹到亚段支气管水平，所以支气管扩张剂只能解决肌肉痉挛造成的哮鸣。给了沙丁胺醇仍不消的哮鸣，要想到炎症或黏膜水肿。

points.en: Generations 17-23 (terminal bronchioles and alveoli, the lung parenchyma) have no cilia, no mucus blanket, no smooth muscle. Emphysema destroys what little structure they have, so they collapse on exhalation and trap air.
points.zh: 第 17-23 级（终末细支气管和肺泡，即肺实质）没有纤毛、没有黏液毯、没有平滑肌。肺气肿把仅有的支撑结构也破坏掉，于是呼气时塌陷、气体被困在肺里。

points.en: Surfactant lowers alveolar surface tension; lose it (or underinflate) and alveoli collapse into atelectasis. Collapsed alveoli are much harder to reopen — the body prevents this with sighs, yawns, and coughs.
points.zh: 表面活性物质降低肺泡表面张力；一旦缺乏（或长期吸气不足），肺泡塌陷形成肺不张。塌瘪的肺泡要重新吹开难得多——身体靠叹气、打哈欠和咳嗽来预防。

points.en: Chronic lung disease strains the right heart twice over: destroyed capillary beds raise resistance, and chronic hypoxia breeds polycythemia that thickens the blood. Right heart failure caused by lung disease = cor pulmonale.
points.zh: 慢性肺病给右心上了双重枷锁：毛细血管床被毁使阻力升高，慢性缺氧又催生红细胞增多让血液变稠。肺病引起的右心衰竭就叫肺心病（cor pulmonale）。

sections.titleZh: 气道问题 vs 呼吸问题

points.en: An open airway does not guarantee ventilation. A hypoventilating patient on oxygen can hold a decent SpO2 while CO2 quietly climbs — hypercapnia plus respiratory acidosis, both lethal if uncorrected.
points.zh: 气道通畅不等于通气足够。通气不足的病人吸着氧可以把 SpO2 撑在过得去的水平，而 CO2 在暗中攀升——高碳酸血症加呼吸性酸中毒，不纠正都能致命。

points.en: Watch which phase is hard: struggling to exhale = obstructive lower airway disease (asthma, COPD); struggling to inhale = upper airway obstruction.
points.zh: 看病人卡在哪个相：呼气费劲＝下气道阻塞性疾病（哮喘、COPD）；吸气费劲＝上气道梗阻。

points.en: Normal breathing is negative pressure (air pulled in past the glottis, bypassing the esophagus). Bag-mask ventilation is the physiologic opposite — positive pressure pushes air toward both trachea and esophagus, so poor technique inflates the stomach.
points.zh: 正常呼吸是负压（空气被吸过声门，基本不进食管）。球囊面罩通气在生理上正好相反——正压会把气同时推向气管和食管，手法不好就把胃吹起来。

points.en: Flail segments get sucked inward and sucking chest wounds let air enter through the wall — both sabotage the negative-pressure pump. In infants the still-flexible thorax shows the same physics as retractions.
points.zh: 连枷胸的游离段会被吸进去，开放性胸壁伤让空气从伤口灌入——两者都在破坏这台负压泵。婴幼儿胸廓还软，同样的物理就表现为吸气性凹陷。

points.en: Kussmaul respirations: deep and fast, driven by metabolic acidosis (think DKA — fruity breath, dry cracked lips). Central neurogenic hyperventilation looks identical but comes from raised ICP or brain injury and produces respiratory alkalosis.
points.zh: Kussmaul 呼吸：又深又快，由代谢性酸中毒驱动（想到 DKA——烂苹果味呼气、口唇干裂）。中枢神经源性过度通气模式一模一样，但根源是颅压升高或脑损伤，结果是呼吸性碱中毒。

points.en: Apneustic breathing (long inspiratory hold, 'fish breathing') and ataxic/Biot patterns (chaotic rate and depth with apneic runs) both flag severe brain injury or brainstem herniation.
points.zh: 长吸式呼吸（吸气末长时间屏住，「鱼式呼吸」）与共济失调/Biot 呼吸（节律深度全乱、夹杂呼吸暂停）都是严重脑损伤或脑干疝的标志。

points.en: Cheyne-Stokes (crescendo-decrescendo with apneic pauses) is common in deep sleep and intoxication; it turns ominous only when grossly exaggerated or paired with head trauma — apneic gaps can then stretch 30-60 seconds.
points.zh: 潮式呼吸（渐强渐弱、中间夹呼吸暂停）在深睡和醉酒者中很常见；只有在明显夸张或合并颅脑外伤时才算凶兆——那时暂停期可拉长到 30-60 秒。

points.en: Agonal gasps are stray impulses from a dying brainstem. Pulseless patients may still gasp now and then — do not let an occasional gasp delay CPR.
points.zh: 濒死叹息样呼吸是垂死脑干发出的零星冲动。无脉病人也可能偶尔抽一口气——绝不能因为这一口气延误 CPR。

points.en: Tachypnea is not hyperventilation. Fast shallow breathing (a panting dog) can actually be hypoventilation; hyperpnea describes depth, not rate. Judge minute volume, not the counter.
points.zh: 呼吸快不等于过度通气。又快又浅的呼吸（像狗喘气）实际可能是通气不足；hyperpnea 说的是深度而非频率。要评的是分钟通气量，不是数次数。

points.en: Assisting a conscious patient with a BVM is a real skill: oversized breaths fire the Hering-Breuer stretch reflex and trigger coughing fits. Small, timed breaths win.
points.zh: 给清醒病人用球囊辅助呼吸是门真功夫：打气太大会触发 Hering-Breuer 牵张反射，让病人连声呛咳。小潮气量、卡准节奏才是正解。

points.en: Hypoxia timeline in the brain: anxiety and restlessness come early; confusion, lethargy, and coma are late. Rising CO2 does the opposite — it sedates, leaving the patient sleepy and hard to rouse.
points.zh: 大脑的缺氧时间线：焦躁不安来得早，意识混乱、嗜睡、昏迷是晚期。CO2 升高则相反——它有镇静作用，病人昏昏沉沉、叫不太醒。

points.en: Cardiac response ladder: mild hypoxemia drives tachycardia (compensation); severe hypoxia produces bradycardia; uncorrected hypoxia ends in VF or VT.
points.zh: 心脏的反应阶梯：轻度低氧血症引发心动过速（代偿）；重度缺氧转为心动过缓；持续不纠正就是室颤或室速。

points.en: A brief seizure often rides along with a hypoxic event or cardiac arrest; dizziness with tingling extremities suggests hyperventilation instead.
points.zh: 缺氧事件或心搏骤停常伴随一次短暂抽搐；而头晕加四肢发麻更提示过度通气。

points.en: Lying flat (worse in obesity, pregnancy, or a distended abdomen) shoves viscera into the diaphragm — the whole reason for orthopnea. Tight straps, binders, and clothing add the same penalty from outside.
points.zh: 平躺（肥胖、腹胀时更糟）会把腹腔脏器顶向膈肌——这就是端坐呼吸的由来。绑带、束缚带和过紧衣物则从外面加上同样的惩罚。

points.en: Neuromuscular failure (high cord injury, Guillain-Barre, myasthenia gravis, ALS, botulism) shrinks tidal volume and minute volume. These patients need assisted ventilation — oxygen alone fixes nothing.
points.zh: 神经肌肉性衰竭（高位脊髓损伤、吉兰-巴雷、重症肌无力、ALS、肉毒中毒）会让潮气量和分钟通气量一起缩水。这类病人需要辅助通气——光给氧解决不了问题。

points.en: Severe renal disease impersonates lung disease: acidosis makes them hyperventilate, fluid overload makes them fail. Ask about dialysis — the need for emergency dialysis can change your destination.
points.zh: 严重肾病会伪装成肺病：酸中毒让病人过度通气，容量超负荷让病人心衰。要问透析情况——是否需要急诊透析可能直接改变送院去向。

sections.titleEn: Assessing Dyspnea: First Look and History
sections.titleZh: 呼吸困难评估：第一眼与病史

points.en: The tripod position (leaning forward, arms braced) rotates the scapulae out and puts accessory muscles to work. The truly frightening patient is the one in distress who is willing to lie flat — read it as impending collapse.
points.zh: 三脚架体位（前倾、双臂撑住）把肩胛骨外旋，让辅助呼吸肌全力上岗。真正吓人的是明明很喘却愿意平躺的病人——要按崩溃在即来解读。

points.en: Head bobbing — head held up on inhalation, dropping on exhalation — means the muscles are spent. It is frequently preterminal behaviour.
points.zh: 点头样呼吸——吸气时头抬起、呼气时垂下——说明呼吸肌已经耗干。这常常是临终前的表现。

points.en: Purposeful hyperextension (self-imposed sniffing position) maximizes upper-airway flow; think airway swelling, and note that holding it burns precious energy.
points.zh: 刻意后仰（自己摆出嗅物位）是在给上气道争取最大气流；要想到气道肿胀，而且维持这个姿势本身就在烧宝贵的体力。

points.en: Work-of-breathing inventory: bony retractions (peds sternum/ribs), soft-tissue retractions (supraclavicular, intercostal, subxiphoid), nasal flaring, tracheal tugging, and see-saw paradoxical abdominal motion.
points.zh: 呼吸做功清单：骨性凹陷（儿童胸骨/肋骨）、软组织凹陷（锁骨上、肋间、剑突下）、鼻翼扇动、气管拖拽，以及跷跷板样的胸腹反常运动。

points.en: Pulsus paradoxus — peripheral pulses fade or vanish on inspiration — betrays violent intrathoracic pressure swings. Rare, but a severity marker.
points.zh: 奇脉——吸气时外周脉搏减弱甚至消失——暴露了胸腔内压的剧烈摆动。少见，但一出现就是重症标志。

points.en: Minute volume = rate x tidal volume. A normal rate with shallow depth is still hypoventilation; depth is misjudged far more often than rate. Also sniff the breath — acetone means DKA.
points.zh: 分钟通气量＝频率×潮气量。频率正常但很浅照样是通气不足；深度被看走眼的次数远多于频率。顺便闻一下呼气——丙酮味提示 DKA。

points.en: Quiet tachypnea with crystal-clear lungs: think shock, sepsis, acidosis, DKA — not a lung problem. Aerosol bronchodilators do nothing for those.
points.zh: 呼吸快但肺部干干净净：要想到休克、脓毒症、酸中毒、DKA——不是肺的问题。给这些病喷雾化支扩剂毫无用处。

points.en: Speed of onset sorts the differential: seconds-to-minutes = acute bronchospasm, anaphylaxis, PE, or pneumothorax. Left heart failure from a big AMI can kill in minutes; right heart failure builds over days.
points.zh: 起病速度本身就在筛鉴别：数秒到数分钟＝急性支气管痉挛、过敏性休克、肺栓塞或气胸。大面积心梗引起的左心衰几分钟就能要命；右心衰则要几天慢慢堆起来。

points.en: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea — waking suddenly gasping — is an ominous flag for left heart failure, worsening COPD, or both (alveolar fluid and bronchial secretions pool during sleep).
points.zh: 夜间阵发性呼吸困难——睡着睡着突然憋醒——是左心衰、COPD 恶化或两者并存的凶兆（睡眠时肺泡液体和支气管分泌物在悄悄积聚）。

points.en: Distress grading by speech and position: full sentences lying flat = mild; two-to-three-word bursts bolt upright at 90 degrees = severe, possibly life-threatening.
points.zh: 用说话和体位给严重度打分：能平躺、整句说话＝轻；直挺挺坐成 90 度、一次只能蹦两三个词＝重度，可能危及生命。

points.en: History gold: what has the patient already tried and did it work; which medications should they be on; have they ever been intubated and ventilated. Prior intubation marks a high-lethality airway.
points.zh: 病史里的金子：已经试过什么、有没有用；本该在用哪些药；以前有没有被插管上过呼吸机。插管史直接标记这是条高致死风险的气道。

points.en: Cyanosis needs about 50 g/L of desaturated hemoglobin. At a normal 120-140 g/L that means saturation near 65%; anemic patients may die without ever turning blue, while polycythemic COPD patients turn blue early.
points.zh: 发绀需要约 50 g/L 的去饱和血红蛋白。血红蛋白正常（120-140 g/L）时相当于饱和度掉到 65% 左右；贫血病人可能到死都不发紫，而红细胞增多的 COPD 病人很早就发紫。

points.en: Colour clues beyond blue: chocolate-brown mucosa/venous blood = methemoglobin (nitrates, toxins); cherry-red skin in CO poisoning is real but late. Check mucous membranes for moisture too — dehydration shows there first.
points.zh: 蓝色之外的颜色线索：黏膜/静脉血呈巧克力棕＝高铁血红蛋白（硝酸盐类、中毒）；CO 中毒的樱桃红皮肤确有其事但属于晚期。同时看黏膜湿润度——脱水最先写在那里。

points.en: JVD in an upright patient approximates right atrial pressure; add hepatojugular reflux (press the liver, veins bulge further) and you have a specific sign of right heart failure. JVD while supine in a healthy young adult is normal.
points.zh: 端坐位下的颈静脉怒张大致反映右房压力；再加上肝颈静脉回流征（按压肝脏、颈静脉更鼓）就是右心衰的特异性体征。健康年轻人平躺时颈静脉充盈属正常。

points.en: Gross JVD despite hypotension (e.g., BP 80/40) in trauma screams tamponade or tension pneumothorax. Tracheal deviation is late, uncommon, and mostly hides behind the sternum — palpate the suprasternal notch, but never wait for it.
points.zh: 创伤病人血压才 80/40 却颈静脉暴张，直指心包填塞或张力性气胸。气管偏移是晚期、少见体征，而且大多藏在胸骨后面——可以在胸骨上切迹触摸，但绝不能等它出现才行动。

points.en: Lung geography: gravity-dependent pathology (pneumonia, heart failure) lives in the bases — heard only from the back. The right middle lobe hides beneath/lateral to the right breast. The midaxillary line gives the cleanest left-right comparison and the best tube-placement check.
points.zh: 肺的地理学：受重力支配的病灶（肺炎、心衰）都住在肺底——只有从背部才听得到。右中叶藏在右侧乳房下方偏外。腋中线是左右对比最干净的位置，也是核对插管位置的最佳听诊点。

points.en: Sound physics: fluid transmits sound better than air. Wet or consolidated lung sounds louder in the periphery (bronchial sounds where vesicular belongs); the hyperinflated COPD/asthma chest sounds distant or absent.
points.zh: 声音物理学：液体比空气更善于传声。湿肺或实变的肺在外周反而更响（本该是肺泡音的地方听到支气管音）；过度充气的 COPD/哮喘胸腔则声音遥远甚至消失。

points.en: Consolidation test trio: bronchophony (spoken '99' comes through intelligibly), egophony ('E' heard as 'A', prominent over pleural effusion), whispered pectoriloquy (whispers stay understandable).
points.zh: 实变三联试验：支气管语音（说「99」能听清词）、羊鸣音（发「E」听成「A」，胸腔积液上方尤其明显）、耳语音（悄悄话仍能听懂）。

points.en: Wheezes are high-pitched and continuous; diffuse in asthma and heart failure, localized when a foreign body or secretions plug one bronchus. One-sided wheeze: have the patient cough, then listen again.
points.zh: 哮鸣音高调而连续；哮喘和心衰是弥漫性的，异物或痰栓堵住一支支气管时是局限性的。一侧哮鸣音：让病人咳一下再听一次。

points.en: Crackles are discontinuous pops from air spaces snapping open — fluid. Rhonchi are low-pitched continuous sounds from secretions in big airways. Terminology overlaps; describe what you hear.
points.zh: 湿啰音是气腔啪地弹开的断续爆裂声——提示液体。干啰音是大气道分泌物造成的低调连续音。术语彼此交叠，关键是如实描述你听到的。

points.en: The most ominous chest is a silent one: no breath sounds means almost no air movement. In asthma, silence is not improvement — it is peri-arrest.
points.zh: 最凶险的胸腔是安静的胸腔：听不到呼吸音意味着几乎没有气体在流动。哮喘病人「安静下来」不是好转——是快要停了。

points.en: Sputum tells stories: frothy pink = heart failure; purulent = infection; thick = dehydration or antihistamines; clear/white = bronchitis; blood-streaked = tumour, TB, pulmonary edema, or just violent coughing. Always ask whether colour or amount changed.
points.zh: 痰会讲故事：粉红泡沫痰＝心衰；脓性痰＝感染；黏稠痰＝脱水或抗组胺药；清亮/白色＝支气管炎；带血丝＝肿瘤、结核、肺水肿，或只是咳得太猛。永远要问颜色和量有没有变化。

points.en: SpO2 above 95% is normal; most healthy people feel short of breath below 90%. Cold extremities, poor perfusion, and tremor corrupt the reading; the oximeter's displayed heart rate should match the palpated pulse.
points.zh: SpO2 高于 95% 算正常；多数健康人掉到 90% 以下就会觉得气短。肢体冰冷、灌注差、抖动都会污染读数；血氧仪显示的心率应与触诊脉搏对得上。

points.en: Pulse oximetry cannot tell oxygen from carbon monoxide on hemoglobin. Baseline COHb runs 1-2% (3-4% in smokers), and CO-poisoned patients can read normal or high — only a CO-oximeter unmasks them.
points.zh: 脉搏血氧仪分不清血红蛋白上挂的是氧还是一氧化碳。基线 COHb 约 1-2%（吸烟者 3-4%），CO 中毒病人的读数可以正常甚至偏高——只有 CO 血氧仪能拆穿。

points.en: The oxyhemoglobin dissociation curve is steep at low saturations: a hypoxic patient on 2 L/min nasal cannula may jump 80% to 92%, while a healthy one on a nonrebreather crawls 96% to 99%. The same steepness means hypoxic patients desaturate fast.
points.zh: 氧解离曲线在低饱和度段很陡：缺氧病人用 2 L/min 鼻导管就能从 80% 跳到 92%，而健康人戴非再吸入面罩只从 96% 爬到 99%。同样的陡坡也意味着缺氧病人掉饱和度掉得飞快。

points.en: Colorimetric ETCO2: a tube in the trachea of a perfused patient shows 4-5% CO2 (yellow); esophageal placement shows under 0.5% (purple). Carbonated-beverage gas in the stomach can fake a positive — confirm across at least six breaths.
points.zh: 比色法 ETCO2：管子在有灌注病人的气管内应显示 4-5% CO2（黄色）；插进食管则不足 0.5%（紫色）。胃里的碳酸饮料气体可以造出假阳性——至少连续确认 6 次呼吸。

points.en: Waveform capnography adds shape: the tracing identifies air-trapping disease (asthma, COPD), documents breathing pattern, and alarms for apnea, bradypnea, and tachypnea.
points.zh: 波形二氧化碳监测多给一层信息：波形形态能识别气体潴留性疾病（哮喘、COPD），记录呼吸模式，还能对呼吸暂停、过缓、过快报警。

points.en: Peak expiratory flow: normal adults run roughly 350-700 L/min. Canadian asthma guidelines call under 300 L/min a moderate exacerbation and under 200 L/min severe with significant distress.
points.zh: 呼气峰流速：正常成人大约 350-700 L/min。加拿大哮喘指南把低于 300 L/min 定为中度发作，低于 200 L/min 为重度、伴显著窘迫。

points.en: The tongue is the number-one airway killer in unresponsive patients. Take away the pillow a bystander placed behind the head and reposition. Postictal, intoxicated, and hypoglycemic patients travel safely in the recovery position, which also cuts aspiration risk.
points.zh: 无反应病人的头号气道杀手是舌头。把旁观者垫在脑后的枕头抽走、重新摆正体位。癫痫发作后、醉酒和低血糖病人可以安全地侧卧位（复原体位）转运，还能顺带降低误吸风险。

points.en: Poiseuille law: shrink a tube's diameter and resistance climbs exponentially. That is why the same virus that barely bothers an adult gives a small child croup — their airways start narrow.
points.zh: 泊肃叶定律：管径一缩小，阻力呈指数级上升。同一株病毒成人几乎没感觉、小孩却得了哮吼，就是因为孩子的气道天生就窄。

points.en: Croup: viral, peaks between 6 months and 3 years, seal-bark cough, winter and early spring, often improves with cool humid air. Distressing but rarely fatal. Do not manipulate the airway.
points.zh: 哮吼（croup）：病毒性，好发 6 个月到 3 岁，海豹吠样咳嗽，冬季和早春多见，接触凉爽湿润空气常会缓解。看着吓人但很少致命。不要刺激气道。

points.en: Epiglottitis: rapid bacterial emergency (classically Haemophilus influenzae type b), any age, any season. Drooling + fever + hoarse voice + deliberate head hyperextension. True emergency — hands off the airway.
points.zh: 会厌炎：进展迅猛的细菌性急症（经典致病菌为 b 型流感嗜血杆菌），不分年龄不分季节。流涎＋发热＋声音嘶哑＋刻意仰头。真正的急症——绝不去碰气道。

points.en: The abscess pair: peritonsillar (young adults, one-sided swelling behind the tonsil) and retropharyngeal (children, fever with sudden stridor). Add diphtheria's grey pseudomembrane. All can mimic epiglottitis; all carry the same rule — no airway manipulation.
points.zh: 两种脓肿：扁桃体周围脓肿（年轻成人，扁桃体后一侧肿起）和咽后脓肿（儿童，发热伴突发喘鸣）。再加白喉的灰色假膜。它们都能装成会厌炎，也都遵守同一条规矩——不要刺激气道。

points.en: Forced to intubate a swollen infected airway: pick a tube at least two full sizes smaller, have a partner press the chest while you watch for a stream of bubbles marking the glottis. One failed attempt, then go straight to needle or surgical cricothyrotomy.
points.zh: 迫不得已要给肿胀的感染气道插管时：选小至少两个整号的管子，让同伴压胸、你盯着找标记声门的气泡流。只允许失败一次，之后直接改行环甲膜穿刺或切开。

points.en: Aspiration of stomach contents carries high mortality. Triple-aggressive rule: aggressively prevent (avoid gastric insufflation, decompress with an NG tube), aggressively monitor airway protection (advanced airway if it fails), aggressively suction and control the airway when it happens.
points.zh: 误吸胃内容物的死亡率很高。三个「狠」字诀：狠抓预防（通气别把胃吹胀、该置鼻胃管减压就置）、狠盯气道保护能力（保护不了就上高级气道）、真发生了就狠吸引、果断控制气道。

points.en: Adults choke when intoxicated, traumatized, or gag-impaired (stroke, aging). Chronic food aspiration is a common source of pneumonitis in older patients — never let a patient in respiratory difficulty keep eating.
points.zh: 成人被噎住多发生在醉酒、外伤或咽反射减退（卒中、高龄）时。慢性食物误吸是老年人肺炎（吸入性肺损伤）的常见来源——绝不要让呼吸费力的病人继续进食。

sections.titleEn: Obstructive Airway Disease: Asthma and COPD
sections.titleZh: 阻塞性气道疾病：哮喘与 COPD

points.en: Obstructive mechanism: positive exhalation pressure pinches small airways shut, so the harder the patient pushes, the more air gets trapped. Slow, low-pressure exhalation empties more — exactly what pursed lips achieve. These diseases affect 10-20% of adults.
points.zh: 阻塞的机制：呼气正压把小气道压瘪，病人越用力呼，气越被困住。缓慢低压地呼反而排得更多——缩唇呼吸做的正是这件事。这类疾病影响 10-20% 的成年人。

points.en: The obstructive signature: pursed-lip breathing, I:E ratio stretched from the normal 1:2 out to 1:6 or 1:8, abdominal muscles recruited for every exhalation (asthmatics report belly pain after an attack — hundreds of involuntary sit-ups), and JVD from trapped-air chest pressure.
points.zh: 阻塞性疾病的招牌动作：缩唇呼吸；吸呼比从正常的 1:2 拉长到 1:6 甚至 1:8；每次呼气都要动用腹肌（哮喘病人发作后常喊肚子痛——相当于做了几百个仰卧起坐）；胸腔困气升压造成颈静脉怒张。

points.en: Asthma = airway inflammation plus reversible bronchospasm, in acute attacks with quiet intervals. Canadian scale: about 3.8 million patients; roughly 250 adults and 20 children die of it yearly; it is the most common chronic disease of childhood (12.5% of children).
points.zh: 哮喘＝气道炎症加可逆的支气管痉挛，发作呈阵发性、间歇期可以毫无症状。加拿大的体量：约 380 万患者；每年约 250 名成人和 20 名儿童死于哮喘；它是儿童期最常见的慢性病（患病率 12.5%）。

points.en: Bronchospasm drug ladder: beta-2 agonist (salbutamol) is first-line; anticholinergics (ipratropium, tiotropium) assist; epinephrine appears for life-threatening asthma; magnesium sulfate 2-4 g IV over 15-20 minutes is an ED-level option for moderate-to-severe attacks.
points.zh: 支气管痉挛的用药阶梯：β2 受体激动剂（沙丁胺醇）是一线；抗胆碱药（异丙托溴铵、噻托溴铵）协同；危及生命的哮喘会用到肾上腺素；硫酸镁 2-4 g 静脉 15-20 分钟输完是急诊层面处理中重度发作的选项。

points.en: Corticosteroids attack the root cause — inflammation — but need hours to act. Bronchodilators buy time; steroids end the attack.
points.zh: 糖皮质激素打的是病根——炎症——但起效要数小时。支扩剂负责争取时间，激素负责终结这次发作。

points.en: Status asthmaticus: a severe attack that conventional treatment cannot break. Working assumption: any asthmatic sick enough to call 9-1-1 is in status until proven otherwise — expect a hyperinflated, near-silent chest and an exhausted, acidotic, dehydrated patient.
points.zh: 哮喘持续状态：常规治疗压不下去的重度发作。工作假设：病到肯打 9-1-1 的哮喘病人，除非证明不是，一律按哮喘持续状态对待——预期看到过度充气、近乎无声的胸腔，和一个精疲力竭、酸中毒、脱水的病人。

points.en: Fatal-asthma risk flags: prior near-fatal event, ICU admission, or intubation; two or more admissions or three or more ED visits; two or more rescue inhalers a month; nocturnal awakenings; coexisting cardiac disease or COPD; medication noncompliance.
points.zh: 致死性哮喘的危险信号：曾有濒死性发作、进过 ICU 或被插过管；住院 ≥2 次或急诊 ≥3 次；每月用掉 ≥2 支急救吸入器；夜间憋醒；合并心脏病或 COPD；不好好用药。

points.en: Emphysema — the pink puffer: alveolar walls dissolve into inefficient blebs, chest becomes a barrel, muscle mass gets cannibalized for the work of breathing, tachypneic but relatively pink.
points.zh: 肺气肿——「粉红喘客」：肺泡壁溶解成低效的大疱，胸廓变成桶状，肌肉被呼吸做功一点点吃掉，呼吸急促但脸色相对红润。

points.en: Chronic bronchitis — the blue bloater. Official definition: sputum-producing cough on most days, at least 3 months a year, for over 2 years. Typically a heavy smoker, overweight, congested, hypercapnic and hypoxemic, often with cor pulmonale.
points.zh: 慢性支气管炎——「蓝色臃肿者」。官方定义：一年中至少 3 个月、大多数天都有痰咳，且持续超过 2 年。典型形象是重度吸烟者，偏胖、痰声重、高碳酸伴低氧血症，常合并肺心病。

points.en: A COPD patient who calls 9-1-1 has a reason — they live with baseline misery. Hunt the trigger: pneumonia (fever, changed sputum), right heart failure (peripheral edema, JVD with hepatojugular reflux), sudden left heart failure or AMI, or an environmental exacerbation (weather change, heating switch-on, triggers).
points.zh: 肯打 9-1-1 的 COPD 病人一定有原因——他们平日就与不适共存。要主动找扳机：肺炎（发热、痰变样）、右心衰（外周水肿、颈静脉怒张伴肝颈回流征）、突发左心衰或心梗，或环境性加重（变天、暖气开机、接触诱因）。

points.en: Hypoxic drive is real but rare — a small end-stage subset. Oxygen depresses their breathing slowly (drowsiness, dwindling rate), never sudden apnea. The chapter's verdict: withholding oxygen from someone who needs it makes no sense; give it, watch, and be ready to ventilate.
points.zh: 低氧驱动确有其事但罕见——只见于一小撮终末期病人。氧气对他们的抑制是缓慢的（先犯困、呼吸频率慢慢往下掉），绝不会一口氧就骤停。教材的结论：因为怕这个就对需要氧的人扣着不给毫无道理；该给就给，盯紧，随时准备辅助通气。

points.en: Auto-PEEP: if each bagged breath cannot fully escape before the next, thoracic pressure stacks up, choking venous return and courting pneumothorax and cardiac arrest. Bag severe asthma/COPD at as few as 4-6 breaths/min (standard adult rate is only 10-12).
points.zh: auto-PEEP：球囊打进去的每口气若来不及完全呼出就叠上下一口，胸腔内压层层加码，掐断静脉回流，还会招来气胸和心搏骤停。重度哮喘/COPD 病人捏球囊可以低到每分钟 4-6 次（标准成人也不过 10-12 次）。

points.en: All that wheezes is not asthma: acute left heart failure (cardiac asthma), smoke inhalation, chronic bronchitis, and PE all wheeze diffusely; a localized wheeze means focal obstruction (foreign body, tumour). Asthma treatment and heart-failure treatment differ radically — history decides.
points.zh: 会喘鸣的不都是哮喘：急性左心衰（心源性哮喘）、烟雾吸入、慢性支气管炎、肺栓塞都能弥漫性哮鸣；局限性哮鸣则指向局部阻塞（异物、肿瘤）。哮喘和心衰的处置南辕北辙——靠病史来裁决。

points.en: TB red flags: weight loss, night sweats, fever, blood-tinged sputum. Protection is airflow and barriers: N95/duckbill mask on you, an oxygen mask (not cannula) on the patient, vehicle exhaust fan running.
points.zh: 结核的警示组合：消瘦、盗汗、发热、痰中带血。防护靠气流和屏障：自己戴 N95（鸭嘴）口罩，给病人扣氧气面罩（而不是鼻导管），车辆排风一直开着。

points.en: Restrictive disease (severe kyphosis, scoliosis, chest-wall problems) limits lung expansion. It rarely generates the 9-1-1 call itself, but it strips away reserve when anything else hits.
points.zh: 限制性疾病（重度驼背、脊柱侧弯、胸壁问题）限制的是肺的扩张。它本身很少成为报警原因，但任何别的病来袭时，它把储备功能提前掏空了。

sections.titleEn: Infections, Toxic Inhalation, and Pulmonary Edema
sections.titleZh: 感染、毒气吸入与肺水肿

points.en: An asthma flare that responds to each treatment but rebounds within hours usually has an infection (pneumonia, bronchitis) re-pulling the trigger. Ask about fever, chills, and colourful sputum — the wheeze will not stay gone until the infection is treated.
points.zh: 每次治疗都见效、几小时后又卷土重来的哮喘发作，背后通常有个反复扣扳机的感染（肺炎、支气管炎）。要问发热、寒战和痰的颜色——感染不治，哮鸣就断不了根。

points.en: MDI failure modes: propellant sprays on with zero drug left; heat-damaged or expired canisters; bad timing that coats the mouth instead of the lungs. Sloshing sounds on shaking do not prove medication remains. A spacer solves the timing problem.
points.zh: 定量吸入器的失灵方式：药早喷完了、喷出来的只剩抛射剂；被高温毁掉或过期的药罐；按压吸气配合不好、药全糊在嘴里。摇一摇有液体声不代表还有药。储雾罐能根治配合时机问题。

points.en: Predictable call surges: the first cold snap or heat wave that flips on dormant heating/AC systems (full of off-season growth) pushes chronic respiratory patients over the edge. So do therapy noncompliance and abruptly stopped oral corticosteroids.
points.zh: 可以预告的出勤高峰：第一波寒潮或热浪让闲置整季的暖气/空调（里面长满了脏东西）集体开机，把慢性呼吸病人成批推下悬崖。擅自停药，尤其是口服激素骤停，同样会制造危机。

points.en: Test with exertion: compare SpO2 at rest versus walking to the stretcher, going to the bathroom, or eating. Check infants during feeding or crying — that is their exercise test.
points.zh: 用活动来测试：对比静息与走向担架、上厕所或进食时的 SpO2。婴儿要在吃奶或哭闹时查——那就是他们的运动负荷试验。

points.en: Pneumonia profile: days of weakness, fever, productive cough, sometimes pleuritic pain; often right after influenza; may open with a shaking chill. Exam: toxic appearance, unilateral basal crackles, increased tactile fremitus, sometimes consolidation signs. Risk groups: COPD/asthma, bedridden, postoperative, immunocompromised, smokers, the old.
points.zh: 肺炎的画像：数天乏力、发热、咳痰，有时胸膜性胸痛；常紧跟在流感之后；可以以一场寒战开场。查体：中毒面容、单侧肺底湿啰音、触觉语颤增强，有时有实变征。高危人群：COPD/哮喘、卧床、术后、免疫低下、吸烟者和老人。

points.en: V/Q vocabulary: dead space = ventilated but not perfused (PE, shock); shunt = perfused but not ventilated (pneumonia, atelectasis); silent unit = neither (cardiac arrest). Shunted blood reaches the left heart still deoxygenated — that is the hypoxemia of pneumonia.
points.zh: 通气/血流词汇表：死腔＝有通气无血流（肺栓塞、休克）；分流＝有血流无通气（肺炎、肺不张）；沉默单位＝两样都没有（心搏骤停）。分流的血没带上氧就回了左心——肺炎的低氧血症正源于此。

points.en: Pneumonia prehospital care: oxygen, suction for secretions, IV fluids for the near-universal dehydration, transport. Bronchodilators do not treat pneumonia itself — they only ease coexisting bronchospasm. Over 6,000 Canadians die of pneumonia yearly.
points.zh: 肺炎的院前处理：给氧、吸引分泌物、为几乎人人都有的脱水补液、转运。支扩剂治不了肺炎本身——只能缓解并存的支气管痉挛。加拿大每年有超过 6,000 人死于肺炎。

points.en: Toxic gases sort by water solubility: highly soluble (ammonia) sears the moist upper airway on contact; poorly soluble (phosgene, nitrogen dioxide) slips deep and brews pulmonary edema up to 24 hours later; chlorine sits mid-range and can do either. Remove from exposure, 100% oxygen, assist ventilation.
points.zh: 毒气按水溶性分拣：高水溶（氨气）一接触就灼伤湿润的上气道；低水溶（光气、二氧化氮）悄悄潜入深部，最迟 24 小时后酿成肺水肿；氯气居中，两头都占。处理：脱离接触、100% 氧、必要时辅助通气。

points.en: Pulmonary edema march: end-inspiratory crackles at the bases → crackles climbing to the subscapular level and apices → coarse crackles in both phases with tactile fremitus → pink, foamy sputum. That last finding is a classic danger sign of severe edema.
points.zh: 肺水肿的行军路线：吸气末肺底湿啰音 → 湿啰音爬到肩胛下水平乃至肺尖 → 双相粗湿啰音伴触觉语颤 → 咳出粉红色泡沫痰。最后这一幕是重度肺水肿的经典危险信号。

points.en: ARDS: alveoli stiffen after trauma, shock, aspiration, or hypoxic insult, and ventilation itself can worsen the damage. Prehospital prevention is concrete: avoid high airway pressures and big tidal volumes in pneumonia, chest trauma, and hypoxemic respiratory failure.
points.zh: ARDS：创伤、休克、误吸或缺氧打击后肺泡变硬，而通气本身还会加重损伤。院前预防很具体：肺炎、胸部创伤和低氧性呼衰的病人，打气别用高压、别用大潮气量。

points.en: End-of-life respiratory calls: titrate naloxone only until breathing is adequate — fully reversing a hospice patient's opioids dumps them back into uncontrolled pain. Aerosolized fentanyl is even used deliberately for intractable cough in end-stage lung cancer.
points.zh: 临终相关的呼吸出勤：纳洛酮只滴定到呼吸够用为止——把安宁疗护病人的阿片全逆转掉，等于把人重新扔回失控的疼痛里。雾化芬太尼甚至被特意用来压制晚期肺癌的顽固咳嗽。

sections.titleEn: Pleura, Pulmonary Circulation, and Ventilation Disorders
sections.titleZh: 胸膜、肺循环与通气障碍

points.en: Spontaneous pneumothorax: a congenital or COPD bleb ruptures — from something as small as a cough or as violent as aggressive bagging. Typical host: tall, thin, young, often a smoker; also severe asthmatics. Story: sharp pain after coughing, then dyspnea mounting over minutes to hours.
points.zh: 自发性气胸：先天或 COPD 形成的肺大疱破了——诱因小到一声咳嗽，大到粗暴的球囊通气。典型宿主：瘦高的年轻人，常吸烟；重度哮喘病人也在名单上。剧情：咳嗽后一阵锐痛，随后呼吸困难在数分钟到数小时内步步加重。

points.en: Most spontaneous pneumothoraces need high-concentration oxygen and close monitoring en route — not a needle. Decompression is for tension physiology.
points.zh: 大多数自发性气胸需要的是高浓度氧和途中严密监测——不是穿刺针。减压是留给张力性生理表现的。

points.en: Pleural effusion can hold several litres: breath sounds vanish over the fluid, dyspnea worsens with position change, and the patient will fight anything but Fowler position. Field care = position of comfort, aggressive oxygen, transport for definitive drainage.
points.zh: 胸腔积液可以攒下好几升：积液上方呼吸音消失，一换体位就更喘，病人会抗拒 Fowler 坐位以外的任何姿势。现场处理＝舒适体位、大方给氧、送去做确定性引流。

points.en: PE is one of the most frequently misdiagnosed conditions in emergency medicine: sudden dyspnea with or without sharp chest pain and a deceptively clear chest. The clot usually starts as a leg DVT (swollen calf, tenderness) and rides through the right heart into the pulmonary artery.
points.zh: 肺栓塞是急诊界误诊率最高的疾病之一：突发呼吸困难，可伴锐性胸痛，肺部听着却出奇干净。血栓通常起家于下肢深静脉（小腿肿、压痛），一路穿过右心卡进肺动脉。

points.en: PE risk inventory: recent surgery, immobilization, long car or air travel, clotting disorders, certain cancers, pregnancy, oral contraceptives (especially smokers) — yet a large share are idiopathic with no identifiable factor.
points.zh: 肺栓塞危险因素清单：近期手术、制动、长途乘车或飞行、凝血异常、某些癌症、妊娠、口服避孕药（吸烟者尤甚）——但仍有一大批是查无诱因的特发性病例。

points.en: A saddle embolus straddling the pulmonary artery bifurcation can be immediately fatal; fibrinolytics may be the only shot in the unstable patient. Arrest from massive PE: deep cyanosis of face, neck, chest, and back that persists despite good CPR and 100% oxygen.
points.zh: 骑跨在肺动脉分叉处的鞍状栓塞可以当场致命；对不稳定的病人，溶栓可能是唯一的机会。大面积肺栓塞导致的骤停有个特征：脸、颈、胸、背深度发绀，CPR 和纯氧再到位也退不下去。

points.en: Ventilation arithmetic: normal PaCO2 is 35-45 mm Hg, kept there by roughly 500 mL tidal volume at 12-16 breaths/min — a minute volume of 6-8 L. CO2 up = pH down (respiratory acidosis); CO2 blown off = alkalosis.
points.zh: 通气的算术：PaCO2 正常值 35-45 mm Hg，靠约 500 mL 潮气量 × 每分钟 12-16 次呼吸维持——分钟通气量 6-8 L。CO2 升＝pH 降（呼吸性酸中毒）；CO2 吹掉太多＝碱中毒。

points.en: Hypoventilation has four root categories: impaired lung function (severe asthma, COPD, pneumonia, edema), broken mechanics (high cord fracture, flail chest, obesity, binding), neuromuscular failure (brain injury, cord injury above C5, Guillain-Barre, ALS, botulism), and depressed drive — with opioid overdose the most common EMS hypoventilation crisis.
points.zh: 通气不足的四大根源：肺功能受损（重症哮喘、COPD、肺炎、肺水肿）、力学被破坏（高位颈椎骨折、连枷胸、肥胖、束缚）、神经肌肉失灵（脑损伤、C5 以上脊髓损伤、吉兰-巴雷、ALS、肉毒中毒）、驱动被压制——其中阿片类过量是 EMS 最常见的通气不足危机。

points.en: Hyperventilation syndrome: blowing off CO2 raises pH, and the alkalosis brings perioral and hand-foot tingling while the patient feels unable to breathe — anxiety then deepens the loop, sometimes to syncope.
points.zh: 过度通气综合征：CO2 被吹掉、pH 升高，碱中毒带来口周和手足发麻，病人却自觉喘不上气——焦虑再把循环拧得更紧，甚至可以晕过去。

points.en: Never use the paper bag (or a rebreather at 21%): the patient exhausts their oxygen, and in the field you cannot exclude DKA, toxic ingestion, or sepsis breathing fast to survive acidosis. Coach instead: talk calmly, breathe together, count between breaths, distract.
points.zh: 永远别用纸袋（或 21% 氧的部分重吸面罩）：袋里的氧很快耗尽，而且在现场你排除不了 DKA、中毒或脓毒症这些靠喘气续命的酸中毒。正确做法是引导：平静交谈、跟病人一起呼吸、数着数换气、转移注意力。

sections.titleZh: 呼吸困难处置与呼吸药理

points.en: The management ladder: secure the airway (suction, position of comfort) → cut the work of breathing (sit up, loosen clothing and straps, never make them walk, relieve gastric distention) → oxygen → bronchodilators → careful fluids or diuresis → CPAP/BPAP → BVM → intubation.
points.zh: 处置阶梯：保住气道（吸引、舒适体位）→ 削减呼吸做功（坐起、松开衣物束带、绝不让病人走动、缓解胃胀气）→ 给氧 → 支扩剂 → 谨慎的补液或利尿 → CPAP/BPAP → 球囊面罩 → 插管。

points.en: Fluid is a two-edged tool: a bolus helps the dehydrated young pneumonia or asthma patient, but can tip an older or cardiac patient into pulmonary edema. Auscultate before and after every bolus.
points.zh: 补液是把双刃剑：一袋液体能救脱水的年轻肺炎/哮喘病人，也能把老年或心脏病病人直接推进肺水肿。每次补液前后都要听一遍肺。

points.en: Furosemide is for patients who clearly have wet lungs plus peripheral edema. Diuresing a pneumonia or asthma patient makes them worse; renal-failure patients may not respond at all. Not every crackle is pulmonary edema — when transport is short, let the hospital decide with imaging and labs.
points.zh: 呋塞米留给明确「肺又湿、腿又肿」的病人。给肺炎或哮喘病人利尿只会雪上加霜；肾衰病人可能根本不应答。不是每声湿啰音都是肺水肿——转运时间短的话，让医院拍了片、验了血再定夺。

points.en: Intubation judgment calls: it is the LAST resort in severe asthma (nearly impossible to ventilate, pneumothorax-prone); ventilate proactively before arrest (a patient who tolerates bagging is ready); if dextrose or naloxone could flip the picture, bag for a few minutes first.
points.zh: 插管的分寸：对重度哮喘它是最后手段（插上也极难通气、动辄气胸）；要抢在骤停前主动通气（能忍受你捏球囊的病人就是该插的病人）；如果一支葡萄糖或纳洛酮可能让局面反转，先捏几分钟球囊观察。

points.en: A properly used MDI rivals a nebulizer: only 5-micron particles riding smooth laminar flow reach the alveoli. The spacer suspends them for minutes, removes the press-and-inhale timing problem, and cuts drug lost to the mouth.
points.zh: 用得对的定量吸入器不输雾化器：只有 5 微米级的颗粒乘着平稳的层流才到得了肺泡。储雾罐能让药雾悬浮数分钟，免去按压与吸气的对表难题，还减少糊在口腔里的浪费。

points.en: MDI coaching pearls: suck, never blow into the spacer; a harmonica squeal means inhaling too hard (turbulence dumps drug in the trachea); hold the breath a few seconds; first puff opens airways so the second lands deeper; rescue bronchodilator before all other inhalers; rinse the mouth after corticosteroids (thrush).
points.zh: 带教定量吸入器的口诀：对储雾罐只吸不吹；听到口琴声说明吸太猛（湍流会把药甩在气管壁上）；吸完屏气几秒；第一喷开路、第二喷才进得深；急救支扩剂永远排在其他吸入剂前面；吸完激素要漱口（防鹅口疮）。

points.en: Nebulizer mechanics: at least 6 L/min gas flow to generate the right particle size; a running treatment delivers only about 30-40% oxygen, so a severely hypoxic patient may be better served by the nonrebreather; stop conversation during treatment so the mist actually gets inhaled.
points.zh: 雾化器的机械学：至少 6 L/min 气流才打得出合格的颗粒；雾化进行中只能供到约 30-40% 的氧，重度缺氧者可能戴非再吸入面罩更划算；治疗期间停止问话，让病人专心把药雾吸进去。

points.en: Salbutamol (Ventolin) is the standard beta-2-selective rescue drug, onset about 5 minutes. BC dosing: nebulized 5 mg over age 1 (2.5 mg under 1 year), repeatable as required; adult MDI 4 x 100 mcg. Cautions: coronary disease, COPD with degenerative heart disease, diabetes.
points.zh: 沙丁胺醇（Ventolin）是标准的 β2 选择性急救药，起效约 5 分钟。BC 剂量：雾化 1 岁以上 5 mg（1 岁以下 2.5 mg），可按需重复；成人 MDI 4 喷 × 100 mcg。慎用：冠心病、合并退行性心脏病的 COPD、糖尿病。

points.en: Ipratropium is the anticholinergic partner — it releases the parasympathetic brake while beta-2 agonists press the gas. BC: adult 500 mcg nebulized as a SINGLE dose (salbutamol repeats, ipratropium does not), or MDI 160 mcg (8 x 20); pediatric 250 mcg nebulized, never under 30 days old. Never monotherapy; caution in glaucoma and prostatic hypertrophy.
points.zh: 异丙托溴铵是抗胆碱搭档——β2 激动剂踩油门，它负责松开副交感的刹车。BC：成人雾化 500 mcg 且只给一次（沙丁胺醇可重复、异丙托溴铵不重复），或 MDI 160 mcg（8 喷 × 20）；儿科雾化 250 mcg，出生 30 天内禁用。绝不单药使用；青光眼和前列腺增生慎用。

points.en: When airways are too tight to carry inhaled drug in, go around them: BC PCP gives epinephrine 0.5 mg IM every 5-20 minutes for severe bronchospasm with impending failure, or when SpO2 stays under 90% with moderate-severe symptoms despite salbutamol.
points.zh: 气道紧到连吸入药都送不进去时，就绕开气道：BC 的 PCP 对濒临呼衰的重度支气管痉挛给肾上腺素 0.5 mg 肌注、每 5-20 分钟一次；沙丁胺醇用了 SpO2 仍低于 90% 且症状中重度时同样适用。

points.en: Dexamethasone (BC PCP): 8 mg with PO preferred (IV/IO/IM possible) for bronchospasm in asthma/COPD and for croup; pediatric 0.5 mg/kg to a max of 16 mg, mixable with juice. Systemic steroids need hours — you will not see the effect on scene.
points.zh: 地塞米松（BC PCP）：8 mg，首选口服（也可 IV/IO/IM），用于哮喘/COPD 的支气管痉挛和哮吼；儿科 0.5 mg/kg、上限 16 mg，可以兑果汁。全身激素起效以小时计——现场看不到效果是正常的。

points.en: Corticosteroid systemics 101: a short 5-7 day course needs no taper; long-term use brings Cushing syndrome, runaway glucose, and a blunted immune system, and must be tapered — never stopped cold. A single emergency IV bolus (methylprednisolone, hydrocortisone) is considered safe.
points.zh: 全身激素常识：5-7 天的短疗程不需要减量；长期使用会带来库欣综合征、血糖失控和免疫钝化，必须逐步减停——绝不能一刀切断。急诊单次静推（甲泼尼龙、氢化可的松）被认为是安全的。

points.en: Methylxanthines (theophylline, aminophylline) have fallen from grace: significant cardiac side effects and burdensome level monitoring; overdose brings dysrhythmias and hypotension. You will still meet long-term COPD patients carrying them.
points.zh: 甲基黄嘌呤类（茶碱、氨茶碱）已经失宠：心脏副作用明显、血药浓度监测麻烦，过量会致心律失常和低血压。但你仍会遇到揣着它们的老 COPD 病人。

points.en: Pulmonary edema pharmacology: nitroglycerin slashes preload fast; morphine eases pain, anxiety, and adds vasodilation but can crush respiratory drive and blood pressure — titrate; loop diuretics dump potassium, so untreated losses invite dysrhythmias and cramps.
points.zh: 肺水肿的药理套餐：硝酸甘油快速砍前负荷；吗啡镇痛抗焦虑外加扩血管，但能压垮呼吸驱动和血压——务必滴定；袢利尿剂排钾，不补的话请来的就是心律失常和肌肉痉挛。

points.en: Tracheal drug instillation is nearly retired: IO is the preferred fallback when IV fails. Only in cardiac arrest with no IV and no IO may select drugs go down the tube — at 2 to 2.5 times the usual dose, per local protocol.
points.zh: 气管内给药基本退役：静脉失败后首选骨髓腔。只有心搏骤停且 IV、IO 都建立不了时，才允许把特定药物从管子里灌下去——剂量放大到常规的 2-2.5 倍，且要遵当地协议。

points.en: Antitussives comfort but can sedate, depress drive, and plug airways with retained secretions; many OTC syrups hide antihistamines. Weigh sleep against secretion clearance.
points.zh: 镇咳药能换来舒适，也能镇静、压呼吸驱动、让分泌物淤成痰栓；许多非处方糖浆里还藏着抗组胺成分。要在睡个好觉和排痰通畅之间掂量。

atScene.en: Noisy breathing is obstructed breathing. Decode the noise: snoring = tongue (reposition the head), gurgling = fluid (suction now), stridor = laryngeal swelling (handle the airway gently and move).
atScene.zh: 有声音的呼吸就是有梗阻的呼吸。破译噪音：鼾声＝舌根后坠（调整头位），咕噜声＝液体（立刻吸引），喘鸣＝喉部肿胀（轻拿轻放气道，赶紧走）。

atScene.en: Do not bag a patient to death. In severe asthma/COPD every breath must fully escape before the next goes in; stacked breaths build auto-PEEP, strangle venous return, and can end in pneumothorax or arrest. Fight the instinct to squeeze fast — 4-6 breaths/min may be right.
atScene.zh: 别把病人「捏」死。重度哮喘/COPD 病人每口气必须完全呼出去才能进下一口；叠加的气会堆出 auto-PEEP、掐死静脉回流，最后以气胸或骤停收场。压住想快捏的本能——每分钟 4-6 次可能才是对的。

atScene.en: Any asthmatic who feels sick enough to call an ambulance is in status asthmaticus until proven otherwise. And in the acute attack, silence is not golden — it is deadly.
atScene.zh: 病到肯叫救护车的哮喘病人，除非证明不是，一律按哮喘持续状态处理。而且在急性发作里，安静不是金——是催命符。

atScene.en: COPD patients negotiate a truce with their disease over years; a 9-1-1 call means the truce broke. Never write it off as 'just their COPD' — find what changed.
atScene.zh: COPD 病人花了多年和疾病谈成停战协议；打 9-1-1 说明协议破裂了。永远别用一句「老毛病而已」带过——去找那个变化。

atScene.en: All that wheezes is not asthma: acute left heart failure, smoke inhalation, chronic bronchitis, and PE wheeze too, and their treatments diverge sharply. History and a full exam decide before the nebulizer does.
atScene.zh: 会喘鸣的不都是哮喘：急性左心衰、烟雾吸入、慢支、肺栓塞也会哮鸣，而它们的处置分道扬镳。先让病史和完整查体拍板，再轮到雾化器。

atScene.en: TB screen on scene: weight loss + night sweats + fever + blood-tinged cough raises the flag. Wear the N95/duckbill, put an oxygen mask (not a cannula) on the patient, and keep the vehicle exhaust running — the best protection is airflow.
atScene.zh: 现场结核筛查：消瘦＋盗汗＋发热＋咳血丝痰就要升旗。自己戴 N95（鸭嘴）口罩，给病人扣氧气面罩（别用鼻导管），车辆排风保持开启——最好的防护是空气流动。

atScene.en: Not everyone breathing fast and deep is hyperventilating. Quiet tachypnea may be shock, DKA, or sepsis compensating for acidosis — and the paper bag has no place in any of it.
atScene.zh: 呼吸又快又深的不一定是过度通气。安静的呼吸急促可能是休克、DKA 或脓毒症在为酸中毒代偿——纸袋在这里没有任何戏份。

confusions.en: A normal SpO2 does not mean the patient is safe: ventilation can be failing while oxygen supplementation props up the number — CO2 keeps climbing, and the oximeter never sees it.
confusions.zh: SpO2 正常≠病人安全：吸着氧的通气衰竭可以把数字撑得很好看，而 CO2 一路上爬——血氧仪对此全程失明。

confusions.en: Still able to talk does not mean mild: two-word answers from a tripoding patient are compensation on its last legs, not reassurance.
confusions.zh: 还能说话≠病情轻：三脚架体位下一次只能蹦两个词，是代偿走到强弩之末，不是安慰剂。

confusions.en: Respiratory care is not just oxygen: often the real enemy is the work of breathing or failed ventilation, which oxygen alone cannot fix — that is what positioning, CPAP, and assisted ventilation are for.
confusions.zh: 呼吸处理≠给氧完事：真正的敌人常是呼吸做功过高或通气失败，这些光靠氧解决不了——体位、CPAP 和辅助通气才是为它们准备的。

confusions.en: Breathing fast is not hyperventilating: rapid shallow breathing may be hypoventilation with a falling minute volume, and quiet tachypnea should make you think shock or acidosis, not reach for a nebulizer.
confusions.zh: 呼吸快≠过度通气：又快又浅可能恰恰是分钟通气量在下滑的通气不足；而肺部干净的呼吸急促应该让你想到休克或酸中毒，而不是伸手去拿雾化器。

confusions.en: Wheeze does not equal asthma: cardiac asthma (left heart failure), smoke inhalation, bronchitis, and PE all wheeze — and treating heart failure as asthma wastes the window.
confusions.zh: 哮鸣≠哮喘：心源性哮喘（左心衰）、烟雾吸入、支气管炎、肺栓塞统统会哮鸣——把心衰当哮喘治，就是在烧抢救窗口。

confusions.en: Crackles do not equal furosemide: pneumonia and asthma also crackle, and diuresing them makes things worse. Reserve diuretics for clearly wet lungs with peripheral edema.
confusions.zh: 湿啰音≠上呋塞米：肺炎和哮喘也有湿啰音，给它们利尿只会更糟。利尿剂留给「肺湿＋腿肿」证据确凿的病人。

confusions.en: Fear of hypoxic drive does not justify withholding oxygen: the phenomenon is rare, slow, and visible (drowsiness, falling rate) — give the oxygen a sick patient needs and watch them.
confusions.zh: 怕低氧驱动≠可以扣氧：这现象罕见、来得慢、看得见（犯困、频率下滑）——病人需要氧就给，盯着就是了。

confusions.en: A quieter asthmatic is not necessarily improving: vanishing wheeze with a silent chest means air movement has collapsed — peri-arrest, not recovery.
confusions.zh: 哮喘病人变安静≠在好转：哮鸣音消失、胸腔无声，说明气流已经崩了——那是骤停前奏，不是康复。

confusions.en: A normal pulse-ox reading in a smoke or exhaust exposure proves nothing: the device counts carboxyhemoglobin as if it were oxygen — CO poisoning hides behind good numbers.
confusions.zh: 烟雾/尾气暴露者血氧读数正常≠没事：仪器把碳氧血红蛋白当氧算——CO 中毒就躲在漂亮数字后面。

mnemonics.name: 粉红喘客 vs 蓝色臃肿
mnemonics.en: Pink puffer = emphysema: thin, barrel-chested, puffing fast, still pink. Blue bloater = chronic bronchitis: heavy, congested, cyanotic, hypercapnic. Real COPD patients sit somewhere between the two poles.
mnemonics.zh: 粉红喘客＝肺气肿：消瘦、桶状胸、喘得快、脸还红润。蓝色臃肿＝慢性支气管炎：偏胖、痰声重、发绀、高碳酸。真实 COPD 病人多在两极之间滑动。

mnemonics.name: 油门与刹车
mnemonics.en: Sympathetic beta-2 = the gas pedal (bronchodilation); parasympathetic = the brake (bronchoconstriction). Salbutamol steps on the gas, ipratropium lifts the foot off the brake — that is why they synergize in one nebulizer.
mnemonics.zh: 交感 β2＝油门（支气管扩张）；副交感＝刹车（支气管收缩）。沙丁胺醇踩油门，异丙托溴铵把踩着刹车的脚挪开——所以两药同一个雾化杯里协同。

mnemonics.name: 99 与 E→A
mnemonics.en: Consolidation talks through the stethoscope: spoken '99' comes through clearly (bronchophony), 'E' morphs into 'A' (egophony), whispers stay intelligible (whispered pectoriloquy). Healthy air-filled lung garbles them all.
mnemonics.zh: 实变会隔着听诊器说话：说「99」能听清（支气管语音）、发「E」变成「A」（羊鸣音）、悄悄话也听得懂（耳语音）。健康含气的肺会把这些全糊成嗡嗡声。

mnemonics.name: CPAP 三上七下
mnemonics.en: Three tickets on: awake and following commands; RR over 24 with accessory muscles; SpO2 under 94% despite oxygen. Seven exits off: age 12 or under, decreased LOC, respiratory arrest/failure, no mask seal, vomiting/aspiration risk, trauma or pneumothorax or tracheostomy, SBP under 90.
mnemonics.zh: 上车三张票：清醒能听指令；RR>24 且动用辅助肌；给氧后 SpO2 仍 <94%。下车七道门：≤12 岁、意识下降、呼吸停止/呼衰、面罩封不住、呕吐或误吸风险、外伤/气胸/气切、收缩压 <90。

mnemonics.name: 倒置的树
mnemonics.en: The airway is an upside-down tree: trachea trunk, 23 generations of branches, alveolar leaves. Generations 1-16 only conduct; 17-19 transition; 20-23 are the respiratory zone where gas is actually exchanged.
mnemonics.zh: 气道是棵倒栽的树：气管当树干，分 23 级枝，肺泡是叶子。第 1-16 级只负责运输；17-19 级过渡；20-23 级才是真正交换气体的呼吸区。

selfCheck.qEn: A COPD patient calls for worsening shortness of breath. How do you give oxygen under the BC guideline, and how does that differ from what many textbooks teach?
selfCheck.qZh: COPD 病人因气短加重呼救。按 BC 考纲怎么给氧？这和很多教材教的有什么不同？
selfCheck.aEn: BC: a COPD patient complaining of SOB gets HIGH-FLOW oxygen, titrated toward SpO2 of at least 94% (nasal cannula 1-3 L/min only after acute treatment). Many courses teach titrated 88-92% for fear of CO2 retention — on the BC exam, high flow wins; hypoxic drive is rare and never causes sudden apnea.
selfCheck.aZh: BC：主诉气短的 COPD 病人给高流量氧，向 SpO2 ≥94% 滴定（鼻导管 1-3 L/min 是急性期处理之后的事）。很多课程因为怕 CO2 潴留教 88-92% 控制性给氧——BC 考试以高流量为准；低氧驱动罕见，而且绝不会一口氧就骤停。

selfCheck.qEn: List the three mandatory CPAP indications, three representative contraindications, and who is allowed to apply it in BC.
selfCheck.qZh: 说出 CPAP 的三个必备指征、三个代表性禁忌，以及在 BC 谁有权使用。
selfCheck.aEn: All three required: RR over 24, SpO2 under 94% on oxygen, accessory muscle use — in an awake, command-following patient 13 or older. Representative contraindications: 12 or under, decreased LOC or respiratory arrest/failure, SBP under 90 (also vomiting, trauma, pneumothorax, tracheostomy, no seal). CPAP is a PCP-level skill; EMR supports with high-flow O2 and BVM.
selfCheck.aZh: 三条缺一不可：RR>24、给氧后 SpO2 仍 <94%、动用辅助肌——且病人清醒能听指令、年满 13 岁。代表性禁忌：≤12 岁、意识下降或呼吸停止/呼衰、收缩压 <90（另有呕吐、外伤、气胸、气切、面罩封不住）。CPAP 是 PCP 级技能；EMR 用高流量氧和球囊做支持。

selfCheck.qEn: Adult nebulizer doses of salbutamol and ipratropium in BC — and which one can be repeated?
selfCheck.qZh: BC 成人雾化的沙丁胺醇和异丙托溴铵剂量各是多少？哪个可以重复？
selfCheck.aEn: Salbutamol 5 mg nebulized (2.5 mg under age 1), repeatable as required; ipratropium 500 mcg nebulized, single dose only (pediatric 250 mcg, never under 30 days). They may share one nebulizer; ipratropium is never monotherapy.
selfCheck.aZh: 沙丁胺醇雾化 5 mg（1 岁以下 2.5 mg），可按需重复；异丙托溴铵雾化 500 mcg，只给一次（儿科 250 mcg，出生 30 天内禁用）。两药可同杯雾化；异丙托溴铵绝不单用。

selfCheck.qEn: Your asthmatic patient's wheeze disappears and the chest goes quiet while they become drowsy. Improving or dying — and what do you do?
selfCheck.qZh: 哮喘病人的哮鸣音消失、胸腔安静下来，人开始犯困。是在好转还是在恶化？你该做什么？
selfCheck.aEn: Dying. A silent chest means air movement has nearly stopped and drowsiness signals CO2 narcosis and fatigue — peri-arrest. Ventilate with a BVM at a slow rate (4-6/min in severe obstruction, letting every breath escape), give IM epinephrine per PCP guideline, and move.
selfCheck.aZh: 在恶化。无声的胸腔说明气流几乎停了，犯困提示 CO2 麻醉和力竭——这是骤停前奏。立即球囊辅助通气且频率放慢（重度阻塞 4-6 次/分，每口气都让它呼完），按 PCP 指南给肌注肾上腺素，快速转运。

selfCheck.qEn: Salbutamol is not touching a severe bronchospasm and SpO2 sits below 90%. What is the BC PCP escalation?
selfCheck.qZh: 沙丁胺醇压不住重度支气管痉挛，SpO2 停在 90% 以下。BC 的 PCP 升级方案是什么？
selfCheck.aEn: Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM, repeatable every 5-20 minutes, for severe bronchospasm with impending failure or SpO2 under 90% unresolved by salbutamol. Add ipratropium to the nebulizer if not yet given, consider dexamethasone 8 mg (PO preferred), and consider CPAP if the patient still qualifies.
selfCheck.aZh: 肾上腺素 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5-20 分钟可重复——适用于濒临呼衰的重度支气管痉挛，或沙丁胺醇用后 SpO2 仍 <90%。异丙托溴铵没给的话加进雾化，考虑地塞米松 8 mg（首选口服），病人仍符合条件就考虑 CPAP。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Mainstream teaching (and many courses) favours controlled, titrated oxygen for COPD — target around 88-92% — for fear of CO2 retention; Nancy itself discusses hypoxic drive but concludes oxygen should not be withheld.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 主流教学（含很多课程）主张 COPD 控制性滴定给氧、目标约 88-92%，理由是怕 CO2 潴留；Nancy 教材讨论了低氧驱动，结论也是不应扣氧。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC guideline is explicit: high-flow oxygen IS indicated for COPD patients complaining of SOB; nasal cannula 1-3 L/min applies only after acute high-flow treatment. Titrate toward SpO2 of at least 94%. On the exam, answer high flow — this is the most dangerous book-versus-BC conflict in the program.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲写得很死：COPD 病人主诉气短就应给高流量氧；鼻导管 1-3 L/min 是急性期高流量处理之后的维持方案。向 SpO2 ≥94% 滴定。考试一律答高流量——这是全课程里最危险的教材冲突，题库审计抓过的头号雷区。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook mentions CPAP/BPAP generically as increasingly common support that can avert intubation, with no licensing detail.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材只泛泛提到 CPAP/BPAP 越来越常用、可帮助避免插管，不涉及执照层级。
bcAlerts.bcEn: In BC, CPAP is a PCP-level skill (EMR does not apply it). Hard criteria: 13 or older, awake and following commands, and ALL of RR over 24 + SpO2 under 94% on oxygen + accessory muscle use. Start 5 cmH2O, step 2.5 at a time, ceiling 10; SBP under 90, vomiting, trauma, pneumothorax, tracheostomy, and respiratory failure all disqualify — those patients get BVM (with PEEP valve, also 5→10 cmH2O).
bcAlerts.bcZh: 在 BC，CPAP 是 PCP 级技能（EMR 不做）。硬性标准：≥13 岁、清醒能听指令，且 RR>24＋给氧后 SpO2<94%＋辅助肌使用三条全占。从 5 cmH2O 起步、每次加 2.5、上限 10；收缩压 <90、呕吐、外伤、气胸、气切、呼衰都出局——这些病人改用球囊（可加 PEEP 阀，同样 5→10 cmH2O）。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The book describes salbutamol as the standard beta-2 rescue agent, routinely given every 4 hours, without field doses.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把沙丁胺醇写成标准 β2 急救药、常规每 4 小时一次，不给现场剂量。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC field dosing: nebulized 5 mg over age 1, 2.5 mg under age 1, repeat as required; adult MDI 4 x 100 mcg (peds by weight: 10-20 kg 5 puffs, over 20 kg 10 puffs, under 10 kg not indicated). MDI plus spacer is strongly recommended when influenza-like illness is suspected. Transport after the first dose.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 现场剂量：雾化 1 岁以上 5 mg、1 岁以下 2.5 mg，可按需重复；成人 MDI 4 喷 × 100 mcg（儿科按体重：10-20 kg 5 喷、>20 kg 10 喷、<10 kg 不用）。疑似流感样疾病强烈建议 MDI＋储雾罐。第一剂给完就启动转运。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 异丙托溴铵剂量与规则
bcAlerts.bookEn: The book introduces ipratropium as the aerosol anticholinergic often premixed with salbutamol, without dosing or restrictions.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把异丙托溴铵介绍为常与沙丁胺醇预混的雾化抗胆碱药，没有剂量和限制。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC: adult 500 mcg nebulized or 160 mcg MDI (8 x 20 mcg) — a SINGLE dose while salbutamol repeats; pediatric 250 mcg nebulized / 80 mcg MDI, contraindicated under 30 days of age; PCP pediatric indication is severe asthma bronchospasm. Never monotherapy; caution in narrow-angle glaucoma and prostatic hyperplasia.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC：成人雾化 500 mcg 或 MDI 160 mcg（8 喷 × 20 mcg）——只给一次，而沙丁胺醇可重复；儿科雾化 250 mcg / MDI 80 mcg，出生 30 天内禁用；PCP 的儿科适应证是哮喘重度支气管痉挛。绝不单药；窄角型青光眼和前列腺增生慎用。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 重度支气管痉挛的肌注肾上腺素
bcAlerts.bookEn: The book notes epinephrine is 'sometimes used' for life-threatening asthma and useful when airways are too closed for inhaled drugs — no dose given.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材只说危及生命的哮喘「有时会用」肾上腺素、气道紧闭到吸入药进不去时有价值——没有剂量。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC PCP has a concrete trigger and dose: 0.5 mg IM every 5-20 minutes for severe bronchospasm with impending respiratory failure, or SpO2 under 90% with moderate-severe symptoms unresolved by salbutamol (MDI or nebulizer). Pediatric 0.01 mg/kg IM to a max of 0.5 mg.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 PCP 有明确扳机和剂量：重度支气管痉挛濒临呼衰，或沙丁胺醇（MDI 或雾化）用后 SpO2 仍 <90% 且症状中重度——肾上腺素 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5-20 分钟一次。儿科 0.01 mg/kg 肌注，上限 0.5 mg。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The book's emergency corticosteroids are IV methylprednisolone or hydrocortisone for acute asthma, with COPD steroids reserved for non-infectious exacerbations.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的急诊激素是静脉甲泼尼龙或氢化可的松治急性哮喘，COPD 用激素还要排除感染。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC PCP carries dexamethasone instead: 8 mg with PO preferred (IV/IO/IM acceptable) as adjunct for asthma/COPD bronchospasm and croup; pediatric 0.5 mg/kg to a max of 16 mg. Cautions: heart failure/hypertension (fluid retention), AMI (myocardial rupture association), first-trimester pregnancy.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 PCP 用的是地塞米松：8 mg、首选口服（IV/IO/IM 也行），作为哮喘/COPD 支气管痉挛及哮吼的辅助治疗；儿科 0.5 mg/kg、上限 16 mg。注意：心衰/高血压（水钠潴留）、心梗（心肌破裂相关性）、妊娠头三个月慎用。
